units.source_text: 他希望遇到那个教半个偈的鬼，

en.t: He hoped to meet the demon who taught half a verse,

units.source_text: 便可以求法为由，将身投与鬼吃。

en.t: so that, under the pretext of seeking the Dharma, he could offer his body to the demon to be eaten.

units.source_text: 这真是一种怪诞的道心。

en.t: This was truly a strange and absurd kind of religious aspiration.
